```{r}
eryth_clusters <- c("3","7", "9")
srt_sub <- subset(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, 
                  sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9 %in% eryth_clusters)
gene_detection <- Matrix::rowSums(GetAssayData(srt_sub,"RNA",layer = "counts")>=3)
srt_sub <- srt_sub[gene_detection>=20,]
options(future.globals.maxSize = 8 * 1024^3)
srt_sub <- SCTransform(srt_sub)
feats <- setdiff(VariableFeatures(srt_sub),sex_degs)
lda_model <- MASS::lda(srt_sub[["SCT"]]@data[feats,] %>% t(),
                       srt_sub$sample.name)
lda_scores <- predict(lda_model, srt_sub[["SCT"]]@data[feats,] %>% t())$x 

lda_scores %>% 
  as.data.frame()%>%
  mutate(sample.name = srt_sub$sample.name[rownames(.)]) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(LD1, LD2, color = sample.name))+
    geom_point()

cbind(lda_model$scaling,cc_cor[rownames(lda_model$scaling),]) %>% View
```
